reuse.why: Fintegra reuses linkBankSyncAccount and findOrCreateBank, and unlinking shares clearAccountBankLink, although transaction downloading copies existing provider logic.

duplication.why: The change duplicates Akahu's download workflow and defines the same bank-link ownership query separately for refusal and replacement.

placement.why: Link policies remain in account orchestration, downloads remain in sync.ts, and provider types and endpoints follow existing module boundaries.

scope.why: The edits support the requested linking rules and Fintegra integration apart from an unrelated schedule import reorder.

maintainability.why: Centralized linking and unlink cleanup simplify ownership, but duplicated ownership predicates and download workflows create avoidable maintenance points.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six provider link handlers use linkBankSyncAccount, and both unlink paths use clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts: downloadFintegraTransactions reproduces downloadAkahuTransactions with provider substitutions and a reshaped retVal declaration.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount adds institution and bankId in place of bank, adds replaceExistingLink, and introduces closed-account rejection and replacement dispatch; every provider still uses the helper.
